final.answer: The average order value in 2017 was $137.31.

metrics.name: average_delivery_days
metrics.label: Average delivery days
metrics.description: Calendar days from purchase date to delivery date, averaged over delivered orders with a delivery date.

metrics.name: average_order_value
metrics.label: Average order value
metrics.description: Revenue divided by delivered orders. Excludes freight.

metrics.name: average_review_score
metrics.label: Average review score
metrics.description: Average stars (1–5) over orders with a review, using the latest review per order.

metrics.name: cancellation_rate
metrics.label: Cancellation rate
metrics.description: Canceled orders divided by orders placed. A fraction between 0 and 1.

metrics.name: customers
metrics.label: Customers
metrics.description: Distinct people with at least one order in the period, counted by customer_unique_id.

metrics.name: delivered_orders_with_date
metrics.label: Delivered orders with a delivery date
metrics.description: Delivered orders that have a recorded delivery date (8 delivered orders lack one).

metrics.name: freight
metrics.label: Freight
metrics.description: Freight charged on items of delivered orders.

metrics.name: gross_merchandise_value
metrics.label: Gross merchandise value
metrics.description: Revenue plus freight on delivered orders.

metrics.name: late_delivery_rate
metrics.label: Late delivery rate
metrics.description: Late orders divided by delivered orders with a delivery date. Late means delivered after the estimated date, compared as dates. A fraction between 0 and 1.

metrics.name: late_orders
metrics.label: Late orders
metrics.description: Delivered orders that arrived after the estimated date, compared as dates.

metrics.name: new_customers
metrics.label: New customers
metrics.description: People whose first order falls in the period. Over all time, every customer.

metrics.name: orders
metrics.label: Orders
metrics.description: Orders placed, any status. Includes canceled and undelivered orders.

metrics.name: payments
metrics.label: Payments
metrics.description: Money paid for delivered orders, including installment interest and vouchers. Differs from revenue + freight.

metrics.name: repeat_customer_rate
metrics.label: Repeat customer rate
metrics.description: Repeat customers divided by all customers, all time. A fraction between 0 and 1. Cannot be limited to a date range.

metrics.name: repeat_customers
metrics.label: Repeat customers
metrics.description: People with two or more orders, all time. Cannot be limited to a date range.
synonyms: customers who ordered more than once

metrics.name: revenue
metrics.label: Revenue
metrics.description: Sum of item prices on delivered orders. Excludes freight. The default meaning of "revenue" and "sales".

result.sql:
WITH sma_10003_cte AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', purchased_at) AS metric_time__day
    , order_id AS order
    , status
    , status AS order__status
    , CASE WHEN order_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __delivered_orders
  FROM "olist"."main"."fct_orders" orders_src_10000
)

SELECT
  CAST(MAX(subq_11.revenue) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(MAX(subq_18.delivered_orders), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS average_order_value
FROM (
  SELECT
    SUM(revenue) AS revenue
  FROM (
    SELECT
      sma_10003_cte.status AS order__status
      , subq_2.__revenue AS revenue
    FROM (
      SELECT
        order_id AS order
        , price AS __revenue
      FROM "olist"."main"."fct_order_items" order_items_src_10000
      WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', purchased_at) BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2017-12-31'
    ) subq_2
    LEFT OUTER JOIN
      sma_10003_cte
    ON
      subq_2.order = sma_10003_cte.order
  ) subq_7
  WHERE order__status = 'delivered'
) subq_11
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    SUM(delivered_orders) AS delivered_orders
  FROM (
    SELECT
      order__status
      , __delivered_orders AS delivered_orders
    FROM sma_10003_cte
    WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2017-12-31'
  ) subq_14
  WHERE order__status = 'delivered'
) subq_18
